items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I had to take a band, I got an all-star band and incidentally, Omer Simeon was in that band.

ctx.x: You got to watch it and it was depressing being around there late all the time, sort of an after hours place in Chicago and it wasn't what I wanted and then -- I am trying to think what actually happened there. I broke up -- my first wife and I separated and I met another woman who owned a place and I put a band in her place. It was a place called the Fourth Estate, a newspaper men's hangout in Chicago, and we made a -- it was a very successful thing for awhile, but then she had a lot of debts and there were some…

She said, 'Let's go to New York where you can get back into the concerts and things, and we were in New York three days and I got an offer to go to Boston to Mrs. Donahue's place, the Savoy, and you know, very good money and of course, I had to take a band, I got an all-star band and incidentally, Omer Simeon was in that band.
